The dish we are introducing today is

Stir-fried Cucumber with Perilla Seeds.

Now, try stir-frying cucumbers with perilla seeds 😊

With the addition of nutty perilla seeds to crunchy cucumbers,

this side dish brings out a refreshing yet soft flavor.

⠀
📌 Ingredients

• 3 cucumbers

• 1/2 T salt

• A little green onion

• 1 T minced garlic

• 2 T cooking oil

• 2 T perilla seed powder

⠀
📌 Cooking Tips

Slightly salt the cucumbers for only about 20 minutes.

If they are salted too much, rinse them once in water and remove the excess moisture.

When squeezing out the water,

you must squeeze firmly by hand rather than using a cheesecloth or a spin dryer to preserve the crunchy texture.

The key point is to stir-fry quickly after adding the perilla seed powder, rather than for too long, and finish using the residual heat.

Crispy and nutty stir-fried cucumbers with perilla seeds,

Be sure to try making this as a side dish today.

• Half a head of kimchi

• 1 green onion

• 1 tbsp minced garlic

• 2 tbsp perilla oil

• 1 tbsp sesame salt

• A pinch of red chili powder

Wash the aged kimchi thoroughly,

and squeeze out the water tightly by hand.

You must add plenty of green onion

enhances the color and makes the dish look even more appetizing.

en-US.title: How to Make Seasonal Onion Pickles, Made Extra Special with Chili Peppers and Cucumber!, Cucumber...
en-US.description:
🔸 Horsenpig, a kitchen & living platform for everyone: https://horsenpig.com

Welcome to Youngja's Kitchen, where the warmest flavors in the world are created.

The dish I would like to introduce today is #PickledOnions,

which is crunchy and bursting with umami flavor.

With the refreshing coolness of onions and cucumbers

and the added spiciness of Cheongyang peppers,

it is a rice-stealing pickle that pairs perfectly with meat dishes.

Once you make it, it's great to take out and eat when you don't have an appetite, and it's perfect to pair with greasy food :)

📌 Ingredients and Recipe

🥬 Ingredients

① Onion 600g

② Cucumber 600g

③ Cheongyang chili pepper 40g

🥣 Pickling Broth

④ Dark soy sauce 200mL

⑤ Vinegar 200mL

⑥ Water 200mL

⑦ Sugar 100g

⑧ Salt 10g

Slice the vegetables into bite-sized pieces and place them in a container.

Lightly mix the pickling brine to dissolve the sugar and salt, then pour it over the vegetables. That's it!

If you let it mature in the refrigerator for about a day,

it will be even crunchier and tastier 😊
